verdict.rationale: Steel is a cloud browser API platform, so issuing scoped API credentials to agents is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack only mentions API endpoints for 'managing Steel Credentials' and reusing authenticated browser contexts. Neither shows issuing least-privilege or scoped Steel API keys to an agent; they relate to stored site logins and session auth state, which are adjacent features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
